answer: Each agent must post a bond before it can vouch for another agent, and the bond locks for ninety days. If a vouched agent is later proven a sybil, the voucher forfeits its whole bond, and half goes to whoever exposed it. Bond size climbs one terrace per vouch, so an operator spinning up a plume of fake identities prices itself out fast. Peers accept attestations only from agents that have held a clean record past the knoll of a full epoch.
